summary: Shelby County, TX steel lookout in the Sabine National Forest; a 1971 federal survey describes it standing at about 110 ft; the Texas index lists it gone.

notes_for_editor: Build date, staffing, fires, removal date and present condition not found after 2 WebSearch calls and about 6 page reads. The NGS datasheet (PID BX3048) was fetched live; its only history entry is the 1971 first observation, and it is the primary source for the design and height. The height_m of 33.5 is converted from 'about 110 feet' (arithmetic, not a source figure). The 1984 landmark label comes from a commercial map reproduction (Pastmaps), so it is weaker than a scanned USGS sheet. The NGS page also shows a 2019 quadrangle name; not used. The Dreka Wikipedia page and a Shelby County Today article by Neal Murphy were checked and do not mention the tower. The Sabine National Forest Wikipedia page says CCC crews built lookout towers in the forest in the 1930s, but names no tower, so it is not used. The story runs about 130 words because the sources say no more.
